files.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an ORIGINAL opaque 1024 x 1536 portrait scrolling terrain tile for an anime aerial shooter, chapter 3 volcanic industrial region.
Input images: Image 1 (the green island) is ONLY the approved art-style and high overhead viewpoint reference: soft visible painterly brushwork, broad natural shapes, restrained short cliff faces and tiny integrated facilities. Do not copy the grass, forest, island shape or sea. Image 2 (the dark volcanic ground) establishes the existing chapter's basalt, lava fissures and industrial exploration theme ONLY; improve its readability and layout, do not copy its excessive darkness or composition.
Primary request: rebuild this volcanic environment with the light, layered, hand-painted anime background finish of reference 1. It must feel viewed from a HIGH-FLYING aircraft, not flying between huge vertical canyon walls. Near-overhead orthographic bird's-eye view, about 80 degrees downward from the horizon. Visible SHORT terrain side faces and little building side walls, primarily viewed roofs and ground, no horizon or isometric diorama.
Composition: this image shows a broad district of volcanic terrain, several irregular connected low basalt shelves, varied sizes of ridges, cooled lava crusts and narrow curving fissures. About 75% quiet blue-slate / violet-gray stone, 15% layered low rock shoulders and broken plate edges, under 8% lava and 2% small facilities. The central 45% remains visually quieter for readable bullets, but is still continuous detailed ground, NEVER an empty black corridor. Thin subdued amber-red lava streams occupy recesses; small warm cores, no blinding white or yellow bloom. Natural cracks, rubble and occasional short winding maintenance paths. Tiny industrial facilities occupy only 2–5% of image width each, with connected foundations, contact shadows, paved approach paths, anchored pipes and supports. No floating or pasted-on objects. Do not repeat the same building shapes or pairs of cylinders.
Lighting: soft daylight from upper RIGHT, all shadows cast lower LEFT; cool atmospheric distance, muted ochre edge highlights and restrained orange lava under-light only near cracks. Clear midtones, not black. Broad hand-painted rock texture, not a smooth 3D render or gritty photo, not muddy smearing.
Tile edges: terrain runs continuously through the top and bottom edge. At BOTH the exact top and bottom, the main narrow lava fissure crosses at x=54% of the width, about 6% width with a dark rim. Avoid focal buildings at the extreme top/bottom 4%; leave naturally textured continuous basalt there, NOT blank separator bands. No broad horizontal road, water stripe, border, image frame or empty end margin. Ground fills all four edges.
Constraints: no clouds, smoke, haze veil or screen-space particles baked into this image; those are separate game layers. No aircraft, enemies, people, projectiles, UI, labels, text, logos, watermarks, pure black gaps or checkerboard. Keep the physical scale small and consistent throughout. No huge vertical pillar walls or giant bridges.
Layout variant A — geothermal outpost: a broken long low basalt shelf at upper-left; a crescent rock formation at lower-right; the lava fissure meanders around a low central cooled crust island. One small ivory-gray geothermal pump station with two different-size tanks and a short anchored pipeline at mid-left; one tiny antenna hut at upper-right, connected to a curving service path. Plenty of smaller rock strata and scattered cooled lava fragments. Distinct asymmetrical groups and varied negative space, not equal repeating blocks.
